claim: § The Honest Artifact: beating between discrete partials is a rendering artifact set by bin count, wrong in detail but true in tendency; § The Pedagogical Gold: change one parameter, re-render, listen.

pieces.what: Strike a crystal tone and raise N from 8 to 300 partials: the beating dissolves into texture while high-first decay remains. Tests which part of the sound is the crystal and which is the rendering.
pieces.walks_up_from: one struck partial with its decay

pieces.what: The four Decision Points as four controls (Frequency Anchor, Rendering Resolution, Decay Scaling, Fidelity Claim) ordered most audible to most conceptual, as the Forward Vectors' lesson asks.
The Fidelity Claim's three paths as three labelled renders of one crystal: discrete, continuous (noise per DOS bin), and the two separated.
